topic: Signing Up for Beginner Swim Lessons

script.title: AT THE POOL DESK
script.scene_zh: 社區泳池 · 櫃台報名
script.story_hook: She signs up, nervous but ready to dive in.
script.intro_zh: 她前來報名，緊張，但準備好下水了。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the community pool front desk. Listen for handy signup phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到社區泳池櫃台。留意實用的報名說法。
script.outro: And that's one signup, done with a smile. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一筆報名就在微笑中完成。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: Showing Up Is the Hard Part
script.char_a_description: a nervous but determined woman in her early thirties with short platinum blonde hair cropped close on one side, small hoop earrings, an oversized charcoal hoodie, gym shorts, canvas sneakers, and a lean athletic build
script.char_b_description: a friendly pool supervisor in his late fifties with a shaved grey head, a thick white mustache, sun-reddened skin, a red lifeguard polo tucked into navy shorts, sandals, and a broad stocky build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, are the swim lessons still open?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɑɹ ðə ˈswɪm ˈlɛsnz stɪl ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問游泳課還在報名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are, though the morning group just filled.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑɹ ðoʊ ðə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ɡɹup dʒʌst fɪld/
dialogue.zh: 還有名額，不過上午班剛剛額滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, I was worried I'd missed it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd aɪ wəz ˈwɜrid aɪd mɪst ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我還以為已經錯過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You didn't. What's your name, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪˈdɪnt wəts jɔɹ ˈneɪm baɪ ðə ˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有錯過。對了，你叫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nora. And honestly, I'm a total beginner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔɹə ænd ˈɑnəstli aɪm ə ˈtoʊɾəl bɪˈɡɪnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 諾拉。老實說，我是完全的初學者。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that's who this class is built for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðæts wu ðɪs ˈklæs ɪz bɪlt fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這個班就是為初學者設計的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what happens in a beginner class?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wəts ˈhæpənz ɪn ə bɪˈɡɪnɚ ˈklæs/
dialogue.zh: 那，初學者班都上些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water comfort first, then floating, then little strokes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔɾɚ ˈkʌmfɚt fɝst ðɛn ˈfloʊɾɪŋ ðɛn ˈlɪɾəl stroʊks/
dialogue.zh: 先讓身體習慣水，然後練漂浮，再學簡單的划水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, can we talk about the deep end?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm kən wi tɔk əˈbaʊt ðə dip ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我們能談談深水池嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. Do you have a fear of it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ du ju hæv ə fɪɹ əv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當然。你怕深水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very. I froze last summer at a lake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛɹi aɪ froʊzd læst ˈsʌmɚ ɛt ə leɪk/
dialogue.zh: 很怕。去年夏天我在湖裡整個僵住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's common, the class moves at your pace.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈkɑmən ðə ˈklæs muːvz æt jɔɹ peɪs/
dialogue.zh: 很常見，課程會跟著你的節奏走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, there's no timed test or anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðɛɹz noʊ taɪmd tɛst ɔɹ ˈɛniˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，沒有計時測驗之類的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No test. On day one, we just wade in.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tɛst ɑn deɪ wʌn wi dʒʌst weɪd ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 沒有考試。第一課只是慢慢走進水裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, my shoulders can relax now, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ maɪ ˈʃoʊldɚz kən ɹɪˈlæks naʊ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我的肩膀終於可以放鬆了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, when works for you, nights or weekends?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛn wɜks fɚ ju naɪts ɔɹ ˈwikˌɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 你什麼時候方便，晚上還是週末？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weekdays are better, work takes my weekends.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwikˌdez ɑɹ ˈbɛɾɚ wɜɹk teɪks maɪ ˈwikˌɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 平日比較好，週末我要上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Tuesday and Thursday, six thirty to seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈtuzˌdeɪ ænd ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪ sɪks ˈθɜɹti tə ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 那就週二和週四，六點半到七點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six thirty... I'll grab a quick dinner first.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈθɜɹti aɪl ɡɹæb ə kwɪk ˈdɪnɚ fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 六點半……那我先快速吃個晚飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. For parking, use the gravel lot out back.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt fɚ ˈpɑɹkɪŋ juz ðə ˈɡɹævəl lɑt aʊt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。停車的話，用後面那片碎石停車場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gravel one by the tennis courts?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡɹævəl wʌn baɪ ðə ˈtɛnəs kɔɹts/
dialogue.zh: 網球場旁邊那個碎石地的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it. Front lot fills up by five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt fɹʌnt lɑt fɪlz ʌp baɪ faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 對。前門的停車場五點就滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. What should I bring with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt wət ʃʊd aɪ bɹɪŋ wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。我需要帶些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A towel, goggles, and a swim cap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaʊəl ˈɡɑɡəlz ænd ə swɪm kæp/
dialogue.zh: 一條毛巾、泳鏡，還有泳帽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you rent caps, or should I buy?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ɹɛnt kæpz ɔɹ ʃʊd aɪ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 泳帽是租借的，還是我得自己買？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Borrow ours the first two weeks, no charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑɹoʊ aʊɚz ðə fɝst tu wikz noʊ tʃɑɹdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 前兩週可以借我們的，不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. One more thing: is the water cold?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ɪz ðə ˈwɔɾɚ koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。再問一件事：水會冷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Indoors it's warm, eighty-two degrees, pretty cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɪnˈdɔɹz ɪts wɔɹm ˈeɪti tu dɪˈɡɹiz ˈpɹɪti ˈkoʊzi/
dialogue.zh: 室內池很溫，華氏八十二度，挺舒服的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that sold me, I hate cold water.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt soʊld mi aɪ heɪt koʊld ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這句就說服我了，我很怕冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight classes run ninety dollars in total.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈklæsəz ɹʌn ˈnɪnti ˈdɑɹəlz ɪn ˈtoʊɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 八堂課總共九十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay online, or here in person?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ ˈɑnˌlaɪn ɔɹ hɪɹ ɪn ˈpɝsən/
dialogue.zh: 可以在線上付，還是當場付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either works. The link goes out by email.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiːðɚ wɜɹks ðə lɪŋk ɡoʊz aʊt baɪ ˈimeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 都可以。繳費連結會用電子郵件發出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, email me the link, that's easiest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈimeɪl mi ðə lɪŋk ðæts ˈiziest/
dialogue.zh: 好，把連結用郵件傳過來，那樣最省事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, um, any medical notes we should know?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ʌm ˈɛni ˈmɛdɪkəl noʊts wi ʃʊd noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那個，呃，有什麼健康狀況是我們該知道的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a sore shoulder, it's fine in water.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə sɔɹ ˈʃoʊldɚ ɪts faɪn ɪn ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 只有一個肩膀容易痠，泡在水裡還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I'll note that for Coach Dana.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt aɪl noʊt ðæt fɔɹ koʊtʃ ˈdənə/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，我會提醒戴娜教練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who teaches it, one person the whole time?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ˈtitʃəz ɪt wʌn ˈpɝsən ðə hoʊl taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 是誰在教？整個課程都是同一位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dana leads, and I help from the deck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdənə lidz ænd aɪ hɛlp fɹəm ðə dɛk/
dialogue.zh: 由戴娜主導，我在池邊從旁協助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I miss a night, work trips happen.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ mɪs ə naɪt wɜɹk trɪps ˈhæpən/
dialogue.zh: 要是請假缺了一次怎麼辦？我常常出差。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make it up Sunday mornings, same gate code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪk ɪt ʌp ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋz seɪm ɡeɪt koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 週日上午可以補課，門禁碼一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's flexible, I like that a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ˈflɛksəbəl aɪ laɪk ðæt ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，好有彈性，我喜歡這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small rule: no lotion before class.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl ɹul noʊ ˈloʊʃən bɪˈfɔɹ ˈklæs/
dialogue.zh: 一條小規定：上課前不能擦乳液。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lotion? Um, is that a pool thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊʃən ʌm ɪz ðæt ə pul θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 乳液？呃，這是泳池的慣例嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It ruins the filter, saves everyone headaches.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɹuːnz ðə ˈfɪɾɚ seɪvz ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn ˈhɛdˌeɪks/
dialogue.zh: 它會弄壞過濾器，大家也少傷腦筋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, noted, no lotion, clean filters.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊɾəd noʊ ˈloʊʃən klin ˈfɪɾɚz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，記下了，不擦乳液，過濾器乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, are you ready to sign up today?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɑɹ ju ˈɹɛdi tə saɪn ʌp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那，今天就要報名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! My hand is up from line one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ hænd ɪz ʌp fɹəm laɪn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 要！我從第一句話就想舉手了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Here's the form, just first name and date.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hɪɹz ðə fɔɹm dʒʌst fɝst ˈneɪm ænd deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這是表格，填名字和出生日期就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signed. Any other paperwork for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪnd ˈɛni ˈpeɪpɚˌwɝk fɔɹ mi/
dialogue.zh: 簽好了。還需要我其他文件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's all. See you Tuesday, six thirty sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɔl si ju ˈtuzˌdeɪ sɪks ˈθɜɹti ʃɑɹp/
dialogue.zh: 就這些。週二見，六點半準時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring a bag right inside with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ bɹɪŋ ə bæɡ ɹaɪt ɪnˈsaɪd wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 我的包包可以帶進場內嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lockers are free, bring a quarter for the lock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɑkɚz ɑɹ fɹi bɹɪŋ ə ˈkwɔɾɚ fɔɹ ðə lɑk/
dialogue.zh: 置物櫃免費，不過要帶一枚硬幣當鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quarter, got it, old-school but cute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwɔɾɚ ɡɑɾ ɪt ˈoʊldˌskul bʌt kjut/
dialogue.zh: 一枚二十五分錢，記下了，復古又可愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're small, we like our quirks, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪɹ smɔl wi laɪk aʊɹ kwɜɹks hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 我們地方小，就愛這些小傳統，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, thanks for calming all my nerves.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl θæŋks fɔɹ ˈkɑmɪŋ ɔl maɪ nɜɹvz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，謝謝你安撫了我全部的神經。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll do fine, showing up is the hard part.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul du faɪn ˈʃoʊɪŋ ʌp ɪz ðə hɑɹd pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 你會表現得很好，現身這一步才是最難的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deep breath time, right, see you Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /dip bɹɛθ taɪm ɹaɪt si ju ˈtuzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我先深深吸一口氣，週二見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Nora, the water's friendlier than it looks.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈnɔɹə ðə ˈwɔɾɚz ˈfɹɛndliɚ ðæn ɪt lʊks/
dialogue.zh: 再見諾拉，水其實比你想像的友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fingers crossed it likes me back, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪŋɡɚz kɹɔst ɪt laɪks mi bæk hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 希望它也喜歡我，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will. Four weeks and you'll float, deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl fɔɹ wiːks ænd jʊl floʊt dil/
dialogue.zh: 一定的。四週後你就會漂起來，成交嗎？

script.youtube_title: 【初學游泳🏊】「現身這一步最難」成人游泳課60句🎧｜怕深水也能全部問清楚💙🧢｜聽完就能自己報名｜Beginner Swim Lessons
script.youtube_title_en: "Showing Up Is the Hard Part" — Signing Up for Beginner Swim Lessons
script.youtube_description:
「現身這一步才是最難的」——一個怕深水的成人，怎麼在社區泳池櫃台報名游泳課？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在泳池大門口。

你會聽到：報名開場的第一句、初學班到底上什麼、深水池的恐懼怎麼開口問、時段與停車怎麼確認、毛巾泳鏡泳帽的清單、缺席怎麼補課，還有付款連結與上課規定。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，夾著美國人真實口語的小語感：um、oh、well、so、ha。聽完你就會用：Are the swim lessons still open?、What should I bring?、Can I pay online?、See you Tuesday。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與開通小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Showing up is the hard part" — how does a nervous adult sign up for beginner swim lessons at a community pool? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the pool front desk.

You will hear: asking if classes are open, talking through the fear of deep water, checking evening times and parking, the towel-goggles-cap list, makeup sessions, lotion rules, and paying by an emailed link.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the small sounds Americans really use: um, oh, well, so, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like What should I bring?, Can I pay online?, and See you Tuesday.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
怕深水，還可以學游泳嗎？成人初學班到底怎麼上課、要不要考試、泳帽毛巾要不要自備？
這一集帶大家走進社區泳池的櫃台，跟著諾拉從報名、問課、說出恐懼，一路聽到付款與約好週二見，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🏊 報名開場：Hi, are the swim lessons still open? 進門第一句這樣問。
💙 說出恐懼：Um, can we talk about the deep end? 不好意思開口時就用這句。
🧢 清單確認：What should I bring with me? 毛巾、泳鏡、泳帽一次問清楚。
📅 補課機制：Make it up Sunday mornings, same gate code. 缺席也有彈性。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、oh、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著諾拉深呼吸一次，下次換你走向櫃台也不緊張。

祝你也找到敢下水的勇氣。
